span.p:
Active means left_at IS NULL.
Unique(party,user); no new row on reactivation.
Host cannot leave. No automatic change on cancellation.

span.p:
History row and original joined_at retained.
Old retry after reapproval can start a new leave cycle;
no per-cycle idempotency key.
Leave has a service but no HTTP endpoint at baseline.
